name: Phantom Fire-Warrior Horde
description: The Dragon-Blooded appears surrounded by a group of fiery warriors, visible only in the target's peripheral vision — they are only phantoms, but intimidating ones that make her presence more imposing. She adds two dice to her Presence for every mote spent, but cannot more than double her Presence Ability.

name: Blazing Courageous Swordsmen Inspiration
description: The Exalt calls up fiery passion in soldiers under his command, and they charge heedless of danger. He spends 1 mote per warrior commanded, to a maximum of twice his Essence, and each receives a single temporary Bruised health level — the first lost when damaged, and it cannot be healed back even by curative magic during that scene. If the soldier is undamaged when the scene ends the bonus fades; if damaged, the lost level disappears with no further ill effect. Usable only on soldiers he directly commands (typically bought with the Command Background); a subject who does not act as part of a unit under his command loses the bonus level immediately. A given individual benefits only once per scene.

name: Glowing Coal Radiance
description: A nimbus of fire encircles the character's head and torso, making it difficult for others to so much as look at him, let alone attack him. Any foe wishing to attack the Exalt in hand-to-hand combat before his next turn must first succeed at a reflexive Willpower test; one success lets the enemy act normally. Enemies may attack the Exalt at range without concern.

name: Aura of Invulnerability
description: The character's force of personality takes on a life of its own; he stares down even the strongest foe, causing enemies to flinch before their weapons hit him. He gains a point of soak and three temporary Bruised health levels for the scene, which are the first lost when he takes damage and cannot be healed back even by restorative magic. When the scene ends the three levels fade whether lost or not, with no ill effect. A character cannot benefit from it more than once per scene.

name: Warlord's Convocation
description: The Exalt's aura of might and overwhelming charisma sway the loyalty of nearly any character. He spends 8 motes and 1 Willpower to attempt to gain a Storyteller character's loyalty: roll Manipulation + Presence, the target reflexively resisting with Willpower. For every net success the target serves as a loyal servant for one week (extendable at the Storyteller's discretion by asking only minor tasks); with five or more successes the target serves long-term, essentially becoming a Henchman — though such servants must be treated well or they may eventually overcome the Charm.

name: Unbearable Taunt Technique
description: The Dragon-Blood becomes adept at getting another's attention and making them look foolish. In combat it grabs the attention of an enemy within 20 yards: the target loses two dice from his dodge and parry pools when fighting anyone other than the Exalt who targeted him. Outside combat, a successful Manipulation + Presence roll and a suitably cutting comment make the target look foolish before an assembled crowd — a dangerous use, best applied sparingly and only before a friendly crowd.

name: Moth to the Candle
description: The character becomes an irresistible target to the Charm's subject, who will cross hazards and place himself in great danger to get off a hand-to-hand attack against her. The target must be within 10 yards and have a lower Essence than the Exalt; he must use his next action to approach and attack her if he can, regardless of intervening hazard. It cannot compel obvious suicide (he will not leap into a chasm), but he will cross damaging hazards such as fires and raging rivers to reach her.
